transactionSize.description: Number of entities to delete per transaction batch. Batches committed before a failure remain durable, and per-id and batch failures are reported in the response. Not supported on a request joining an open transaction. Absent means a single transaction.

pageSize.description: Has no effect: the selection is streamed, so there is no page for it to size. Accepted so that a client sending it is not refused.

pointInTime.description: Point in time, i.e. delete all that existed at this point in time. Must be at or before the consistency time. If not provided, the current state is used.

verbose.description: Include the list of entity ids the delete attempted in the response; an id whose delete failed also appears in the error map.
